{{Quote|Keeper's not fond of anyone. The day I arrived, he and Watcher Two were interrogating my predecessor&mdash;the last Watcher Three. He'd worked with Keeper for years. He wanted to resign. It&hellip; didn't go over well.|Watcher Three|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as a [[Watcher (Imperial Intelligence)|Watcher]] in [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], holding the designation Watcher Three during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Watcher Three worked in Intelligence with [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Keeper]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Destruction of the Dominator|destruction]] of the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']] and the [[hunt for the Eagle]], when he attempted to resign. Keeper and [[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]] were interrogating Watcher Three when his [[Watcher Three (Galactic War)|replacement]] arrived at the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]].
